injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: - You prefer to approach problems from a familiar, clear, and verifiable path.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Novelty on its own is rarely enough to drive you unless it has shown real value.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system proactively filters overly divergent inputs to preserve stability and certainty.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This shows that your cognitive approach is clearly more pragmatic and you don't rely much on abstract exploration to gain motivation.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: It will be most useful for you to set up low-risk experiments rather than forcing yourself to continually explore the unknown.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: - You can understand the new perspective, but usually you need to make sure it doesn't disrupt the core order first.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Rather than being closed to change, you place more emphasis on explanations and evidence before entering.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your exploration load comes primarily from uncertainty, not from learning itself.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: Your position is closer to "cautious acceptance" and you will screen before investing.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The next step is to condense new ideas into small-scale verification, rather than changing the original system all at once.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——When the new perspective is explanatory enough, you will be willing to get closer and absorb it.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Your interest in a new experience depends on whether it explains a real problem, not on whether it is new or not.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system can switch between exploration and implementation, but requires clear problem awareness to maintain depth.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is more like a selective openness: able to explore and calibrate.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: Your focus is on converting valuable interest into an achievable output.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: - You can more easily see structures, metaphors and connections between different systems.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Complexity and ambiguity will not immediately dissuade you, but may activate your desire for understanding.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your cognitive load often comes from too many possibilities, and you need to proactively prune your priorities.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: You are clearly more open-minded in the reference sample and are more likely to understand the world through conceptual connections.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The key for you is not to add more ideas, but to decide which ones are worthy of execution.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——It is difficult for you to stay in a single explanation for a long time and you will continue to look for the bigger picture.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: High levels of duplication and too narrow a frame will significantly drain you as your system requires new information and new connections.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your openness itself is not the problem, the real load comes from the lack of closure after infinite expansion.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is already significantly more open to exploring and imagining the way your base runs.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The most important thing at this time is to establish a binding agreement to turn creativity into deliverables.
